question: A building line ordered and priced: CConstructBuildingCommand whole and who posts it, CBuildingConstruction's layout and its price (slot 14), the day's work for a building line, and the line on the production screen.

addresses.name: CConstructBuildingCommand::CConstructBuildingCommand
addresses.signature: CConstructBuildingCommand* __stdcall CConstructBuildingCommand::CConstructBuildingCommand(CConstructBuildingCommand* this@stack:4, CBuilding* building@stack:8, int province@stack:0xC, CCountryTag country@stack:0x10, int amount@EDI) @EAX
addresses.comment: **The constructor every poster uses** (the production screen's confirm dialog, the province view's building button, the Lua `CConstructBuildingCommand(tag, building, province, amount)`). `ret 0x14`; `this` on the stack, **`amount` in EDI**. CCommand's base set up (class id 0x18D, type ids 0x1C3 at +0x2C/+0x30, +0x34 = 0xFFFF), then building -> +0x3C, province id -> +0x40 (0 for none), country tag -> +0x50/+0x54, amount -> +0x4C. **Mints the line's id** under the spin lock at 0x1B16714: type `0x1268 + word[0x1A857EC]` into +0x44 (4713 in the maintainer's saves), serial `[0x1A857F8] + 1` into +0x48, and the counter moves on by `1 + 3 * amount` - so a command reserves three numbers for each building beyond the line's own (what for is CBuildingConstruction::Deliver's business). Callers: CConfirmBuild::OnAccept (0x7F3A08, province 0, amount = serial), CBuildingMember::OnClick (0x6DC13E, the province, amount 1) and the luabind constructor (0x9898D1).
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x544E10..0x544EE4: `mov esi,[ebp+8]` (this), `mov edx,[ebp+0xc]; mov [esi+0x3c],edx`, `mov eax,[ebp+0x10]; mov [esi+0x40],eax`, `mov [esi+0x50],[ebp+0x14]`, `mov [esi+0x54],[ebp+0x18]`, `mov [esi+0x4c],edi`, `lea edx,[edi+ecx]; lea edx,[edx+edi*2]; mov [0x1a857f8],edx` after `inc ecx`, `add edx,0x1268; mov [esi+0x44],edx; mov [esi+0x48],ecx`, `ret 0x14`. The three call sites set EDI just before the call (`mov edi,1` at 0x6DC139; `mov edi,[edi+0x13c]` at 0x7F39FD; `mov edi,[ebp+0x14]` at 0x9898C3). Wrong if a call site were found that leaves EDI unset.

addresses.name: CConstructBuildingCommand::CConstructBuildingCommand_Prototype
addresses.comment: The empty constructor the command factory's prototype is made with (its one caller is RegisterCommandTypes, 0x885716): the CCommand base with type ids 0x1C3, building null, province -1, id pair 0, amount 0, country `---`. `ret 4`. Named for its one use; the game's own name for it is a second CConstructBuildingCommand constructor.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x544D60..0x544E0A: `mov dword ptr [esi],0x15c3614`, `mov dword ptr [esi+0x40],0xffffffff`, `mov [esi+0x44..0x4c],ebx`, `mov dword ptr [ebp-0x14],0x2d2d2d ... mov [esi+0x50],edx`, `ret 4`; findRefs --callers 0x544D60 gives the one call at 0x885716 inside RegisterCommandTypes (0x885050-0x887F37).

addresses.name: CConstructBuildingCommand::Execute
addresses.comment: **Slot 6: puts a building on the build queue.** Bare `ret` at 0x545169. country = countries[+0x54]; province = provinces[+0x40] (CCurrentGameState +0xB8C). `level = province.buildings[building.index]->level_max / 1000` (truncated). **Where the command names a province (+0x40 != 0) and the queue is not empty**, it walks the queue: every line whose slot 16 says it is a building line (the folded `mov al,1` on CBuildingConstruction, `xor al,al` on the other two) with the same location (+0x44) and the same building (+0x58) adds its size (+0x40) to `level`, and the **last** such line is remembered. **Found: no new line** - `found.size += amount`, but where `amount + level > max_allowed_level` (+0x68) only `max_allowed_level - level` is added (which is nought or less when the province is already full). **Not found, or no province**: a CBuildingConstruction (0x60 bytes) is built in place - status 1000, size 1, location null, builder `---` - takes the command's id pair (+0x44) through slot 6, the country's tag, the building, and **size = amount, uncapped**; CCountry::EnqueueConstruction **appends it at the tail of the queue** (0x545109); slot 14 prices it (0x545115). Then, either way, where the command names a province the line's location is set to it (EnqueueConstruction had zeroed it) and slot 8 is called - the folded `mov al,1; ret` on a building line, so nothing. Last, CDistributeProduction::UpdateNeeded (0x545153). **Nothing is charged, nothing is refused and nothing is said**: no AddProgress (so FINDINGS-oob.md's 'both build commands call it when an item is queued' is wrong for this one), no IC, no message. A merged line is not priced again. Who refuses is IsValid (slot 14), asked by the post and again by the pump before this runs.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x544EF0..0x545169 read whole: `mov eax,[eax+0xb8c]; mov ecx,[ebx+0x40]; mov edx,[eax+ecx*4]`; `mov eax,[ebx+0x3c]; mov eax,[eax+0x54]; mov edx,[edx+0x310]; mov eax,[edx+eax*4]; mov edx,[eax+0x20]` then the /1000 magic; `cmp ecx,edi; je 0x54503d` (no province -> new line); the loop `call [eax+0x40]` / `cmp [edi+0x44],eax` / `cmp ecx,[ebx+0x3c]` / `add esi,[edi+0x40]` / `mov [esp+0xc],edi`; the merge at 0x54511B `lea edi,[edx+esi]; cmp edi,eax; jle; sub eax,esi; add [ecx+0x40],edx`; the new line `push 0x60`, vftable 0x15BDCAC, `mov [eax+0x3c],0x3e8`, `mov [eax+0x40],1`; `call 0x4f5600`; `call [edx+0x38]`; `cmp [ebx+0x40],0; je; mov [ecx+0x44],edx; call [eax+0x20]`; `call 0x51a290`. vtable.py: slot 16 is 0xA92590 on CBuildingConstruction and 0x592360 on the other two. No call to 0x4837D0 in the extent. Wrong if the merge loop's match were not the last line (it overwrites [esp+0xc] on every match).

addresses.name: CConstructBuildingCommand::SaveContents
addresses.comment: Slot 2: CCommand's contents, then `country` (+0x50, quoted), `building` (the building's index, +0x54 of +0x3C), `id` (+0x44 pair), `amount` (+0x4C) and `province` (+0x40). `ret 4`. So the command's own grammar is `country="TAG" building=N id={...} amount=N province=N` - which is what LoadKey reads back.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled and checked against the listing for the five SaveWriteKey calls in that order and the `ret 4`; vtable.py: slot 2 of CConstructBuildingCommand's table.

addresses.name: CConstructBuildingCommand::LoadKey
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CConstructBuildingCommand::LoadKey(CConstructBuildingCommand* this, CParseContext* parse, SaveToken key)
addresses.comment: **Five keys, not three**: `building` (0x1FE, an index looked up in the building database's array at +0xC, into +0x3C), `id` (0xB, ParseObjectId into +0x44), `province` (0x1EE, ParseInt into +0x40), and - in the arm above 0x1FE, which is two `sub`s and not a switch, so the switch reading missed it - `country` (0x24D, CCountryDataBase::GetTag into +0x50/+0x54) and `amount` (0x25F, sscanf into +0x4C). Anything else goes to CCommand::LoadKey. The same five SaveContents writes.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x545310..: `cmp eax,0x1fe; jg 0x5453d9; je 0x54538b; cmp eax,0xb; je; cmp eax,0x1ee; jne 0x5453e8`, and at 0x5453D9 `sub ecx,0x24d; je 0x54543c; sub ecx,0x12; je 0x545406` (0x25F); saveTokens.json gives 0x24D country, 0x25F amount. The decompile shows the GetTag and sscanf arms writing +0x50/+0x54 and +0x4C.
addresses.revises: The record said 3 keys (`building`, `id`, `province`), from FINDINGS-definitions.md's switch reading; the two keys above 0x1FE are compared with `sub`/`je` outside the switch.

addresses.name: CConstructBuildingCommand::IsValid
addresses.comment: **Slot 14, the only refusal a building order meets**: false where the building (+0x3C) is null or the province id (+0x40) is below nought; **true where it is nought** - a line placed later, as the production screen orders one, is never refused here; otherwise CCountry::IsBuildingAllowed(countries[+0x54], building, provinces[+0x40]). Asked by the channel's post and by the session's pump before Execute (FINDINGS-commands.md), and by the AI's Lua before it posts (`loCommand:IsValid()`). A refused command is deleted silently.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x545540..0x54564D: `cmp [edi+0x3c],ebx; jne` else `xor al,al`; `mov eax,[edi+0x40]; cmp eax,ebx; jl (false); jle 0x54563a (true)`; `mov eax,[eax+0xb8c] ... mov eax,[edx+ecx*4]`, `mov ecx,[edx+ecx*4]` with [edi+0x54], `push eax; push [edi+0x3c]; call 0x4dffc0`; bare `ret`.

addresses.name: CBuildingConstruction::CBuildingConstruction

One caller, CCountry::LoadKey (0x4CCF7A), for a `building_construction` block - which then enqueues the line (CCountry::EnqueueConstruction) before its block is read, as a unit line is. CConstructBuildingCommand::Execute builds the same object inline.

addresses.name: CBuildingConstruction::SaveContents
addresses.comment: Slot 2: the shared CConstruction contents (0x4834A0), then `building` = the building's index (+0x54 of +0x58), then `count` (+0x5C) **only where it is not nought** - which is why no save of the maintainer's has a `count` key.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled: FUN_004834a0, SaveWriteKey(building) with `*(this->building + 0x54)`, `if (this->count != 0)` SaveWriteKey(count). Saves of 4 January to 20 April 1936: 171 building_construction blocks, none with `count`.

addresses.name: CBuildingConstruction::RecalculateCost
addresses.comment: **Slot 14, a building line's price.** Bare `ret`. country = countries[+0x4C]; building = +0x58. `cost = building.cost (+0x58)`; where the building's category (+0x88) answers its slot 2 (IsValid - the folded `mov al,1`, true for every category including the null one), `cost = cost * (1000 - GetCategoryBuildDiscount(country, category)) / 1000`, 64-bit, truncated. `+0x30 = cost`; `+0x34 = CCountry_GetBuildingBuildDays(building, country) * 1000`. **That is all**: one building's cost a day and one building's days, whatever the line's size; the same discount on both; no levels term, no by-type term, no build-speed modifier, no reserves, no floor but GetCategoryBuildDiscount's own cap of 990, and **no practical_factor** (that field is CMilitaryConstruction's). The cost is CCountry::GetBuildCost's arithmetic inlined. Called by Execute when a line is made, by CDistributeProduction::Distribute on every remaining line when a line has been finished and removed (0x51A253), by CInGameIdler::Enter on every line of a new game, and on a change of law (CChangeLawCommand::Execute) - the queue-wide callers of slot 14. Measured: 159 of 171 lines in seven saves of 1936 to the thousandth from the save's own practical, law and ic_efficiency level; the other twelve are a head of state's industrial_efficiency and a price older than the save.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x485B30..0x485BC3: `mov esi,[edi+0x58]; mov ecx,[esi+0x88]; mov ebx,[esi+0x58]; call [edx+8]; test al,al; je`; `push [esi+0x88]; push country; lea esi,[esp+0x18]; call 0x4e1ac0; mov ecx,0x3e8; sub ecx,eax; mov eax,ebx; imul ecx; push 0; push 0x3e8; push edx; push eax; call 0xb99980`; `mov [edi+0x30],ebx`; `push country; mov eax,[edi+0x58]; call 0x4dfe00; imul eax,eax,0x3e8; mov [edi+0x34],eax`; bare `ret`. vtable.py --holding: CBuildingConstruction slot 14 alone. Oracle: scratch oracle.py over the 1936 saves (FINDINGS-buildingqueue.md section A.6).

addresses.name: CBuildingConstruction::CanStillBeBuilt
addresses.comment: **Slot 12 of a building line - its own, not CConstruction's 0x4831C0.** Asked of every line at the top of the production pass (0x519DE1); false unlinks and frees the line. False where the line has a location whose controller (+0x338) is not the country (`tag` +4) and the line is not an underground. Otherwise true for any building but the underground. **For an underground**: with no location, CCountry_CanTrainUnderground(country) - so an underground ordered from the production screen is cancelled the first day its country is no longer at war, or is in exile, or has nowhere to put one; with a location, false where the province already has an underground (`level_max` of +0x30C above nought), else Underground_CanPlaceIn's test inlined - the controller at war with the country and the country a friend of the owner, and, for a country neither major nor above 100 MaxIC, the owner the country itself. `ret 4`.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x4864C0..: `mov eax,[ebx+0x44]; test eax,eax; je 0x486509; mov ecx,[edi+4]; cmp [eax+0x338],ecx; je; call [eax+0x2c]; test al,al; je 0x4865e2`; `cmp eax,[ecx+0x28]; jne 0x48661a` (not underground -> true); `test esi,esi; je 0x4865f8` (CanTrainUnderground); `mov ecx,[esi+0x30c]; cmp [ecx+0x20],0; ... jg 0x4865e2`; `call 0x42f1b0` (IsEnemy) and `call 0x4ef7c0` (IsFriend) and `cmp byte ptr [edi+0x15c],0`; three `ret 4`. vtable.py --holding 0x4864C0: CBuildingConstruction slot 12 alone; 0x4831C0 is held only by CMilitaryConstruction and CConvoyConstruction.

addresses.name: CBuildingConstruction::GetName
addresses.comment: Slot 13: the building's name (its slot 6) and, where the line has a location, `" ("` + the province's name + `")"` - "Anti-Aircraft Guns (Praha)". It is what the production screen's queue line writes in `unit_name`. `ret 4`.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled: `(*(this->building->vftable + 0x18))(out)`, then with location `" ("` + GetName of the province's +8 table + `")"` appended; `ret 4` on the listing; CBuildQueueEntry's constructor calls slot 13 (`call [eax+0x34]`) at 0x7F4ADD for `unit_name`.

addresses.name: CCountry_GetBuildingBuildDays
addresses.comment: **How many whole days a country takes to build one of a building.** `ret 4`, the building in EAX. `t = building.time (+0x5C) * 1000`; where the category (+0x88) answers its slot 2 (always), `t = t * (1000 - GetCategoryBuildDiscount(country, category)) / 1000`, 64-bit, truncated; returns `t / 1000`, truncated. So the days are `floor(time * (1 - discount))` with the same discount as the cost, and nothing else: no build-speed modifier, no floor. Callers: CBuildingConstruction::RecalculateCost (0x485BAF), CConfirmBuild::Update (0x7F29DB) and 0x41B3E2 (the custom game's setup).
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x4DFE00..0x4DFE65: `mov esi,eax; mov ecx,[esi+0x88]; call [edx+8]`, `mov edi,[esi+0x5c]; imul edi,edi,0x3e8`, `push [esi+0x88]; push [ebp+8]; lea esi,[ebp+8]; call 0x4e1ac0; mov eax,0x3e8; sub eax,ecx; imul edi; ... call 0xb99980`, the /1000 magic, `ret 4`. findRefs --callers: 0x41B3E2, 0x485BAF, 0x7F29DB. Measured with the cost on 159 of 171 save lines (e.g. 180 days at a discount of -650 is 297, 90 is 148).

addresses.comment: IsBuildingAllowed with the level test replaced by `max_allowed_level >= 0` and nothing counted from the queue: availability, underground or controller, port, the two building lists. `ret 8`. Used by the province view's building button and its update where the custom game's settings say the setup is running (0x6DC085, 0x6DC549, 0x6DC656), where the button sets a level instead of ordering one. The name is ours.

The custom-game reading of its callers rests on the decompile of 0x6DBE40 (`if (*GetCustomGameSettings() == 0) IsBuildingAllowed ... else FUN_004dfe70 ... CCgmSetBuildingLevelCommand`) - inferred.

addresses.name: CConstruction::CanStillBeBuilt
addresses.comment: **Slot 12 of the military and the convoy line - not of the building line, which has its own (CBuildingConstruction::CanStillBeBuilt, 0x4864C0).** Called on every queue item at the top of the production pass (0x519DE1) with &CCountry +0xCA4. True when location (+0x44) is null, or when [[+0x44] + 0x338] equals the tag's id half (+4 of the argument), or when slot 11 ([vftable+0x2C]) answers true; false otherwise, and a false answer makes CDistributeProduction::Distribute unlink, free and destruct the item. Its two holders always have a null location (EnqueueConstruction zeroes it), so **this body never cancels anything**; the cancelling of a building line in a province the country no longer controls, and the underground's own rules, are CBuildingConstruction's slot 12. `this` in ecx, one stack argument, `ret 4`, with two `sete al` tails. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: vtable.py --holding 0x4831C0: CConvoyConstruction slot 12 and CMilitaryConstruction slot 12, nothing else; vtable.py CBuildingConstruction: slot 12 is 0x4864C0. The body itself is unchanged from the record's reading.
addresses.revises: The comment said that because location is a province on building items 'in practice this cancels building projects in provinces the country no longer holds'. A building line never reaches this body: CBuildingConstruction overrides slot 12. Source moved from FINDINGS-production.md to the new write-up.

addresses.name: CConfirmBuild::CConfirmBuild

addresses.comment: **The production screen's confirm dialog** for a building (mode 0), transports (1) or escorts (2), on `confirm_build` (interface/confirmbuild.gui). Makes the window and attaches six buttons: `accept` (OnAccept), `cancel` (OnCancel), `serial_plus`, `parallell_plus` (the file's spelling), `serial_minus`, `parallel_minus`; **parallel (+0x138) and serial (+0x13C) start at 1**. Mode 0: `photo` takes the sprite `picture_` + the building's key where one exists, `label` the building's name (slot 6). Mode 1: `picture_convoy` and the text of `CONVOYS`; mode 2: `picture_escort` and `ESCORTS`. `ret 0x14`.

The three callers are OnBuildingButton, OnConvoyButton and OnEscortButton.

addresses.name: CConfirmBuild::Update
addresses.comment: **Slot 4, every frame.** `paralell_value` (the file's spelling) and `serial_value` are the two counts as integers; either below 1 is set to 1; `parallel_minus` and `serial_minus` are disabled at 1, `parallell_plus` and `serial_plus` at 99 and above. For mode 0: `cost = CCountry::GetBuildCost(country, building)` and `days = CCountry_GetBuildingBuildDays(building, country)`; **`ic_cost_value` is `parallel * cost`, two decimals; `build_time_value` is `serial * days`** - as `N` + " " + the text of `DAYS` where that is 365 or less, else `N / 30` (truncated) + " " + `MONTHS`. (Modes 1 and 2 take the convoy's and escort's own figures.) **The three icons `selected_brigade_red`, `_orange`, `_green` are all hidden and one shown**: spare = the production share's IC (its share times factor times TotalIC) less the sum of every queued line's cost (+0x30); green where `spare - parallel * cost >= 0`, else orange where spare is above nought, else red. Where the building's category answers slot 2: `on_complete_icon` takes the sprite `icon_` + the category's key (+8 of +0x88) where one exists, `on_complete_impact` the text `+` and `completion_size` (+0x8C) to one decimal, and both are handed the category's key. **`accept` is never disabled.** Returns the close byte (+0x28). Bare `ret`.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x7F2490..0x7F3675 indexed by its strings (scratch confirmupdate.txt) and the arithmetic read at 0x7F29B6..0x7F2A21 (`call 0x4dfda0`, `call 0x4dfe00; imul eax,eax,0x3e8`, `imul [ebx+0x13c]*1000`, `imul [ebx+0x138]*1000`, two `call 0xb99980`), 0x7F2AF1..0x7F2B3E (`cmp eax,0x16d; jle` DAYS, /30 MONTHS), 0x7F30C8..0x7F3145 (the share times TotalIC, the queue sum of [esi+0x30], `sub eax,edx`) and 0x7F3277..0x7F330D (`sub edx,[esp+0x50]; js; test eax,eax; jle` red else orange). That [esp+0x50] holds parallel*cost rather than another local at that depth is inferred from the stack bookkeeping and the decompile.

addresses.name: CConfirmBuild::BuildTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __thiscall CConfirmBuild::BuildTooltip(CConfirmBuild* this, GuiTooltipText* out, CGuiObject* element) @EAX
addresses.comment: Slot 6: for `parallel_minus`, `parallell_plus`, `serial_minus` and `serial_plus`, the text of `BUILD_ADD_REM_BUNDLE` ("Ctrl + LMB to add or remove $NUM$") with NUM = 10; every other element, nothing. `ret 8`.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled: four string compares against the element's name (slot 17), then `__itoa(10)` and AppendLocalisedLine("NUM", "BUILD_ADD_REM_BUNDLE"); `ret 8` on the listing.

addresses.name: CConfirmBuild::OnAccept
addresses.comment: **`accept`, "Start Production": posts `parallel` (+0x138) commands**, each built fresh: mode 0 `CConstructBuildingCommand(building (+0x140), province 0, the screen's country, amount = serial (+0x13C))`; mode 1 `CConstructConvoyCommand(0, country)`, mode 2 `CConstructConvoyCommand(1, country)` (0x5496A0). Each goes to the session's channel (its +0x38, slot 6). Sets the close byte (+0x28) first. Bare `ret`.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x7F3980..0x7F3C97: `mov byte ptr [edi+0x28],1`; the loop counter against [edi+0x138] (`cmp eax,[edi+0x138]; jl 0x7f39c0`); `cmp [edi+0x2c],ebx; jne` (mode); `push 0x58; call 0xb9602f`; `mov eax,[edi+0x140]; mov edi,[edi+0x13c]; push ecx; push edx; push ebx(0); push eax; push esi; call 0x544e10`; `mov ecx,[eax+0x38]; call [edx+0x18]`; mode 2 `push 1; call 0x5496a0`, mode 1 `push ebx(0)`.

addresses.name: CConfirmBuild::OnCancel
addresses.comment: `cancel` ("Close"): `mov byte ptr [ecx+0x28], 1; ret` - the close byte Update answers with; nothing is posted.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x7F3D50: two instructions; written into the observer at +0x64 (param_1[0x19]) by the constructor and attached to `cancel`.

addresses.name: CConfirmBuild::OnSerialPlus
addresses.comment: `serial_plus`: where CConfirmBuild_RepeatTick lets it act, serial (+0x13C) += 10 with the key the in-game screen's +0x1C slot 12 answers for held (Ctrl, by BUILD_ADD_REM_BUNDLE), else += 1. No upper cap here; Update disables the button at 99. Bare `ret`.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x7F3D60..0x7F3E44: `call 0x7f3cc0; test al,al; je`; `mov ecx,[eax+0x1c]; call [edx+0x30]; test al,al; je 0x7f3e2e; add dword ptr [esi+0x13c],0xa` / `inc dword ptr [esi+0x13c]`. Which key the slot 12 asks is inferred from the tooltip text.

addresses.name: CConfirmBuild::OnParallelPlus
addresses.comment: `parallell_plus`: parallel (+0x138) += 10 with Ctrl, else += 1, as OnSerialPlus. Bare `ret`.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x7F3E50..0x7F3F34: `call 0x7f3cc0`; `add dword ptr [esi+0x138],0xa` at 0x7F3F06 / `inc dword ptr [esi+0x138]` at 0x7F3F1E.

addresses.name: CConfirmBuild::OnSerialMinus
addresses.comment: `serial_minus`: serial -= 10 with Ctrl, held to its floor, else -= 1. Bare `ret`.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x7F3F40..0x7F4021: `call 0x7f3cc0`; `add dword ptr [esi+0x13c],-0xa; cmp [esi+0x13c],eax; ... mov [esi+0x13c],eax` / `dec dword ptr [esi+0x13c]`. The floor's value (eax) was not traced; Update sets anything below 1 to 1 the next frame either way.

addresses.name: CConfirmBuild::OnParallelMinus
addresses.comment: `parallel_minus`: parallel -= 10 with Ctrl, held to its floor, else -= 1. Bare `ret`.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x7F4040..0x7F4121: `call 0x7f3cc0`; `add dword ptr [esi+0x138],-0xa` ... / `dec dword ptr [esi+0x138]`.

addresses.name: CConfirmBuild_RepeatTick
addresses.comment: Whether a held stepper acts this frame. The timer is +0x144; the press handler (0x7F3CA0) sets +0x148 and starts it. Where the timer is not running, it is started and the answer is yes. Where it is, the answer is yes only once its time is past 0.3 s (while +0x148 is set - the first repeat) or 0.1 s (after), and the timer is then restarted and +0x148 cleared. Bare `ret`. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x7F3CC0..0x7F3D4E: `mov ecx,[esi+0x144]; call [eax+0x18]`; `cmp byte ptr [esi+0x148],0; je`; `movsd xmm0,[0x160a418]` (0.3) / `[0x160a410]` (0.1); `call [eax+0x14]; fcompi; jbe`; `call [eax+8]; call [eax+4]; mov byte ptr [esi+0x148],0; mov al,1`. Which timer slot starts, stops and reads the time is inferred from the shape.

addresses.name: CBuildingMember::OnClick
addresses.comment: **The province view's building button** (`building_member` / `building_icon`, province_interface.gui; the building is +0x28). For every object selected on the in-game screen that is a province (its slot 1 answers 3) **controlled by the player** (+0x338): outside a custom game's setup, where CCountry::IsBuildingAllowed(player, building, province) holds, it posts **CConstructBuildingCommand(building, the province's id (+0xD0), the province's controller tag (+0x334/+0x338), amount 1)** - one level per click per selected province, merged by Execute into a line already queued there. In a custom game's setup it posts CCgmSetBuildingLevelCommand instead, behind CCountry::IsBuildingAllowedIgnoringLevel. Bare `ret`.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x6DC0E5..0x6DC13E: `mov ecx,[eax+0x28]; push ecx; mov ecx,edi; call 0x4dffc0; test al,al; je`; `push 0x58; call 0xb9602f`; `mov edx,[ebx+0x338]; mov ecx,[ebx+0xd0]; push edx; push [ebx+0x334]; push ecx; push [this+0x28]; push eax; mov edi,1; call 0x544e10`. The selection walk, the kind 3 test and the controller test from the decompile of 0x6DBE40; registered as a handler by CBuildingMember's constructor (0x6DB6DA). The custom-game arm was read in the decompile only.

addresses.name: CBuildQueueEntry::CBuildQueueEntry
addresses.signature: CBuildQueueEntry* __stdcall CBuildQueueEntry::CBuildQueueEntry(CBuildQueueEntry* this@stack:4, void* screen@stack:8, CConstruction* line@stack:0xC) @EAX
addresses.comment: The constructor of the production screen's queue line: makes a `queue_entry` window, keeps the line's id at +0x78 and the screen at +0xA0, and attaches the five buttons - `cancel` to OnCancel, `max_prio`, `prio`, `non_prio`, `max_non_prio` to the four priority handlers. **`original_country`** shows the builder's flag where the builder's id (+0x54) is neither nought nor the country's (+0x4C), and is hidden otherwise - so on every building line, whose builder is `---`. Then by the line's kind: **slot 17** (a unit) - `counter_type` the sprite `GFX_counter_` + the first brigade's type key, and `unit_target` `=> ` + the target's name; **slot 15** (a convoy) - `icon_build_convoy`, or `icon_build_escort` where +0x58 is set; **slot 16** (a building) - **`icon_build_` + the building's key (+0x1C of +0x58)** where such a sprite exists, and then a further call on `counter_type` (its slot 73, not read). Last, for every kind, **`unit_name` = the line's slot 13** - for a building "name (province)" - and Update. `ret 0xC`.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x7F4140..0x7F4B66: `mov edi,[ebp+8]` (this), `mov [edi+0xa0],[ebp+0xc]`, `lea edx,[edi+0x78]; push [ebp+0x10]; call 0x7c9530`; the observers 0x7F66B0 (+0x28), 0x7F6F90 (+0xA8), 0x7F7040 (+0xF8), 0x7F70F0 (+0x148), 0x7F71A0 (+0x198) attached to cancel, prio, max_prio, non_prio, max_non_prio; `mov eax,[ecx+0x54]; cmp eax,ebx; je; cmp eax,[ecx+0x4c]; je` around original_country; `call [eax+0x44]` (slot 17), `call [eax+0x3c]` (15), `call [eax+0x40]` (16) with `push 0x15cb998 'icon_build_'; mov eax,[esi+0x58]; add eax,0x1c`; `call [eax+0x34]` (slot 13) into unit_name; `call 0x7f4c90`; `mov eax,edi; ... ret 0xc`.
addresses.revises: Adds a signature (it had none, 'read from its strings only'), the buttons' handlers, the original_country rule, the order of the three kinds and unit_name as slot 13.

addresses.name: CBuildQueueEntry::OnCancel
addresses.comment: **`cancel` on a queue line.** Without Ctrl (the in-game screen's +0x1C slot 12): a CStandardPostConfirm dialog, `CONFIRM_CANCEL_CONSTRUCTION_TITLE` / `_DESC` ("Cancel Construction?" / "Are you sure you wish to cancel this construction?"), carrying a CCancelUnitConstructionCommand(country, the line's id) that is posted on yes. **With Ctrl**: every line of the player's queue with **no more progress (+0x38) than this one** and of the same kind (slots 15, 16, 17 answering alike) and, for a building line, **the same building** (by index), for a convoy line the same escort byte (+0x58), for a unit line the same brigade types in the same order, is collected; two or more open a CMultiCancelPrompt over them, one falls back to the single confirm. Bare `ret`.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole (second.c) and spot-checked: the `cVar2 == 0` arm builds CCancelUnitConstructionCommand_3 and CStandardPostConfirm with the two keys and 'DefaultConfirm'; the Ctrl arm walks the player's Constructions comparing piVar5[0xe] (+0x38) with the clicked line's, slots +0x40/+0x44/+0x3c, `*(piVar5[0x16] + 0x54) == *(*(line + 0x58) + 0x54)` for a building, `(char)piVar5[0x16] == *(char *)(line + 0x58)` for a convoy, the brigade lists' type ids for a unit; `(end - begin) / 0x28 < 2` falls back. CANCEL_MULTI_CONSTRUCTIONS_DESC says Ctrl.

addresses.comment: `prio` ("Increase Priority"): posts CChangePriorityCommand(country, the line's id, -1) - one place forward (FINDINGS-buildqueue.md section 6). Bare `ret`.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled: `uVar6 = 0xffffffff; CChangePriorityCommand(puVar1, tag, tag_id, line id, -1)` then the channel's slot 6.

addresses.comment: `non_prio` ("Decrease Priority"): CChangePriorityCommand(..., 1) - one place back. Bare `ret`.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled: `uVar6 = 1`.

structs.name: CConstructBuildingCommand
structs.comment: Type id 0x1C3. Orders one or more of a building, in a province or (province 0) to be placed later. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-buildingqueue.md, section A.
structs.evidence: operator new(0x58) at every construction site (0x7F39CB, 0x6DC0FD, 0x9898A5) and in Clone; luabind's size 88; RTTI base CCommand at 0; vftable 0x15C3614.

structs.name: CConfirmBuild
structs.comment: The production screen's confirm dialog for a building, transports or escorts (`confirm_build`). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-buildingqueue.md, section A.
structs.evidence: operator new(0x14C) in OnBuildingButton, OnConvoyButton and OnEscortButton; vftable 0x15DECD8 written by its constructor; RTTI base CReloadableInterface (not in the record, so no `inherits`).

structs.name: CBuildingMember
structs.comment: One building's button in the province view (`building_member`). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-buildingqueue.md, section A.
structs.evidence: RTTI: vftable 0x15D3E38, base CStandardlistboxItem at 0; written by the constructor at 0x6DB692. Size not read, so omitted.

struct_fields.name: building
struct_fields.comment: Saved as `building`, by the building's index.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor `mov [esi+0x3c],edx` from its building argument; LoadKey's `building` arm; Execute reads +0x54/+0x58/+0x68 through it.

struct_fields.name: province
struct_fields.comment: Saved as `province`: the province id, **0 for a line to be placed later** (the production screen's), -1 in the empty prototype.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor `mov [esi+0x40],eax`; LoadKey ParseInt; IsValid `jl` / `jle` on it; Execute indexes CCurrentGameState +0xB8C with it.

struct_fields.name: line_id_type
struct_fields.comment: Type half of the id the new line takes (Execute hands &+0x44 to the line's slot 6): 0x1268 + word[0x1A857EC], 4713 in the maintainer's saves. Saved as `id`.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor `add edx,0x1268; mov [esi+0x44],edx`; Execute `lea ecx,[ebx+0x44]; push ecx; call [edx+0x18]`; every building_construction block in the saves has `type=4713`.

struct_fields.name: line_id
struct_fields.comment: Serial half of that id, minted from the counter at 0x1A857F8, which then moves on by 1 + 3 * amount.

struct_fields.name: amount
struct_fields.comment: Saved as `amount`: how many of the building; a new line's size, or what is added to a line already queued in the province (capped at the room left under max_allowed_level).
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor `mov [esi+0x4c],edi`; LoadKey's `amount` (0x25F) arm; Execute `mov eax,[ebx+0x4c]; mov [esi+0x40],eax` and the merge `mov edx,[ebx+0x4c]`.

struct_fields.name: country
struct_fields.comment: Saved as `country`: whose queue the line goes on and whose IsBuildingAllowed IsValid asks.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor stores [ebp+0x14]/[ebp+0x18] at +0x50/+0x54; Execute and IsValid index the country database with +0x54; LoadKey's `country` arm.

struct_fields.name: window
struct_fields.evidence: Every element lookup in Update and the constructor goes through [this+0x20] slot 13/15/17.

struct_fields.name: screen
struct_fields.comment: The screen the dialog was opened from (the production view's +0xB0); its slot 23 gives the country tag the commands are posted for.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor `param_1[9] = param_2`; OnAccept `call [[edi+0x24]+0x5c]` for the tag.

struct_fields.name: close_requested
struct_fields.comment: Set by accept and cancel; Update returns it.
struct_fields.evidence: OnCancel `mov byte ptr [ecx+0x28],1`; OnAccept `mov byte ptr [edi+0x28],1`; Update's last `return *(param_1 + 0x28)`.

struct_fields.name: mode
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor `param_1[0xb] = param_4`; OnAccept and Update switch on [this+0x2c].

struct_fields.name: parallel
struct_fields.comment: How many commands accept posts. Starts at 1, held at 1 or more by Update.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor `param_1[0x4e] = 1`; OnAccept's loop bound; the paralell_value text; the two parallel handlers.

struct_fields.name: serial
struct_fields.comment: The amount of each command: buildings one after another on one line. Starts at 1.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor `param_1[0x4f] = 1`; OnAccept `mov edi,[edi+0x13c]` before the constructor; the serial handlers.

struct_fields.name: building
struct_fields.comment: The building in mode 0; null otherwise.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor `param_1[0x50] = param_5`; OnAccept pushes [edi+0x140]; Update reads its +0x88 and +0x8C.

struct_fields.name: repeat_timer
struct_fields.comment: The timer a held stepper repeats by (CConfirmBuild_RepeatTick).

struct_fields.name: repeat_first
struct_fields.comment: Set when a stepper is pressed; the first repeat waits 0.3 s while it is set, later ones 0.1 s.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x7F3CA0 `mov byte ptr [ecx+0x148],1`; RepeatTick `cmp byte ptr [esi+0x148],0` and its clearing.

struct_fields.name: building
struct_fields.comment: The building this province-view button orders.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor `mov ecx,[ebp+0xc]; mov [esi+0x28],ecx` (0x6DB689); OnClick pushes [this+0x28] to IsBuildingAllowed and the command's constructor.

struct_fields.name: confirm_build
struct_fields.comment: The open confirm dialog, made by OnBuildingButton, OnConvoyButton and OnEscortButton (the previous one destroyed first); BuildTooltip asks it first (FINDINGS-productiontooltip.md section 1).
struct_fields.evidence: `mov [ebx+0x318],eax` after `call 0x7f1800` at 0x8026B3; `mov ecx,[ebx+0x318]; ... call [eax+4]` before it.
